title: Transport sparse checkpoints without assuming entropy is monotone
statement: A maximum of raw past endpoints is invalid because realised entropy can decrease. The actual hidden entropy-descent conditional martingale pays checkpoint selection and descent allowance,transporting each fixed-horizon endpoint into a time-uniform band. Fixed-horizon observed e-values are not thereby supermartingales. The frozen1000-nat target on the specified16-state synthetic CTMC crosses after10082sampled transitions;separate known-source power proof pays the declared cap and truth probability. Inference is not given source parameters used for power. Three specified earlier families receive the SAMEcheckpoint transport and optimistic free tuning envelopes;they fail that target by the cap on this source. Lower-target older-method wins remain;this is not all-method dominance or empirical coverage from two records.
